Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Deck Name : Doomed Henry
Author : Ankha
Description :
Henry Taylor + Condemnation: Doomed infinite combo

The goal is too cycle the whole deck quickly (it should be done by turn 7, thanks to Giotto), put a Condemnation: Doomed on a empty vampire controlled by your prey, block his hunts and untap both Henry and the target using Bond with the Mountain until the prey is ousted.

Crypt [12 vampires] Capacity min: 6 max: 7 average: 6.5
6x  Giotto Verducci  (7)      Baali (group 2)
6x  Henry Taylor  (6)     Brujah antitribu (group 3)

Library [60 cards]

Action [5]
1x  Abbot
4x  Condemnation: Doomed  One per prey

Action Modifier [2]
1x  Forgotten Labyrinth  To make the C:Doomed pass
1x  Horrific Countenance  For Henry for the Eye or anything else

Combat [4]
2x  Bond with the Mountain  Untaps both combattants at
2x  Earth Meld  Early defense

Equipment [2]
1x  Eye of Hazimel  So the Bond with the Mountain costs nothing
1x  Sport Bike  To block the prey's hunt

Master [44]
1x  Archon Investigation  Defense
1x  Dark Influences  Against Psyche! or IG
1x  Dreams of the Sphinx
1x  Giant's Blood
1x  Life in the City
1x  Pentex(TM) Subversion  Can disable the grand-prey's blocking vampire
2x  Protean  For Earth Meld superior
27x  Slaughterhouse, The  Twister card
1x  Spontaneous Power  So Henry get
1x  Sudden Reversal  Against a Hunting Ground or any blood-giving master
1x  Sunset Strip, Hollywood  So your prey's hunt won't be blocked by your grand-prey
1x  Vampiric Disease  To lower the target vampire's blood
3x  Villein  To survive a little until the combo works
2x  Waste Management Operation  To recycle cards that were discarded earlier.

Reaction [3]
1x  Delaying Tactics
1x  Forced Awakening
1x  On the Qui Vive

I played it yesterday, unfortunately my prey played Rack + Faerie Ward wall, so I couldn't play a Condemnation: Doomed on his vampires (I tried 3 times).
I got killed in the end by a Pentex on Henry, but until then I hadn't been bled once.

I need to improve the blood attrition, the Vampiric Disease is not enough and maybe play a Rampage instead of a Sudden.
Dreams is quite useless in the deck (not enough master phase actions, no need to draw). Maybe a PB: Montreal instead for pool gain.

A Parthenon could help too, because the master setup is quite slow.

Prince of Paris, France

Messages.Author: Boris The Blade
Messages.Body:
EDIT: forgot about the first effect of C: Doomed.

Suggested adds:

Mr Winthrop: +1 Intercept is not enough against a stealthy prey.
Hunger Moon: if you fail blocking, you get another chance next turn, and it's a good attrition card anyway.
Unleash Hell's Fury: because you can.
Young Bloods: more attrition.
Impundulu: same, but slower. One of the only unconditional ways to remove the last blood.

Or a completely different approach: add Doris McMillon/Hide the Heart instead of Slaughterhouses. It might even cycle faster if you play them cross table and it trumps Perfectionist.

I don't see how the version you played can take more than 1 sneaky vp: once the table knows your deck, you prey's sick vampires will never tap when they hit 1 blood, and there is nothing you can do about that. The best you can hope for is stalling your prey and finish with bleeds for 1, or maybe prey that they hit 2 blood and you can reduce them to 0 with an Eye of Hazimel rush. You need some tapping tech to play Vampiric disease. And IR goggles to protect Henry from infection.

Messages.Author: Pendargon
Messages.Body:
I like it. It is original, and interesting. However, i do agree that blood burning part is weak, as you need a vampire to hunt in order to score a vp. Therefore, maybe an inclusion of popular evil-doers, such as
Gregory winter
Impundulu
Ossian (he is awesome at removing excess blood  )
Youngbloods
Maybe Society of leopold?

I would also try to add another spontaneous power, as your deck hinges on it.

Messages.Author: Boris The Blade
Messages.Body:
> Ankha wrote:
> Attrition allies cost pool (except Impudulu) and requires actions (that can be blocked)
>
Attrition masters always leave a choice to the target. You do not have to tap with vampiric disease and you can burn the vampire with Society of Leopold (especially if he is already Doomed). I can only see one reliable solution without any action: Vampiric Disease + Nocturn Theater.

Another decent attrition event: Narrow Minds. Not great, but still better than cycling a card for nothing.

You could also play Smiling Jack, but you would end up killing with Jack more often than the Condemnation and you would be disappointed

Messages.Author: technobabble66
Messages.Body:
Luv the deck - *great* original idea w setting up the Henry module & systematically screwing ur prey.
One little query, what is the basic defence against the ol' stealth bleeder? Is the hope a little intercept to slow them enuff to squeeze ur prey first?
And should there be an Elder impersonation to ensure the Doomed gets thru?
Leopold might be handy, but u probably need at least 1 more way to drop the target vamp's blood. I've always liked Free States Rant, but it may be impossible to rely on with this setup. Probably best to go with the gregory winter/impudulu/ossian/young blood combo.
Oh yeah, Hunger moon is awesome for this type of deck (lifesaver in a foul blood deck).

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Against bleed stealth, you'll have to rely on the 2 intercept of Henry (Abbot + Sport bike) and the Archon Investigation.

To get the Doomed through, I rely on the Forgotten Labyrinth. 4 stealth is enough to bypass Pascek + 2nd Tradition and most of the intercept people have.
